item.text:
Audited all 68 verses across 10 stanzas. Corrected Roman spellings, nasal vowels, and source mismatches such as `qaafila`, `Qadam qadam pe sakhtiyaaṅ`, and `Sar-e-Husain`. Verified stanza and verse alignment and preserved the Urdu text byte for byte.

The reading `Dilero` follows the written Urdu and remains uncertain. Human editorial sign-off is pending.
